rule: This ledger certifies modular availability of cinematic/rail/hero/art-loading mechanisms only. It does not certify exact reproduction of the approved non-Mass donor presentation; exact donor fidelity is governed by data/presentation/exact-donor-parity.v1.json and may block FINAL_APP_READY independently.

reference.architecture: presentation-only; no liturgical, data, or navigation ownership

bootCinematic.note: Cold-load boot/transition/loader markup and the observer-free v43.12 presentation owner remain embedded in index.html. Their behavior is release-certified; physical externalization is optional hygiene and not a product-parity blocker.

modularRouteTransitions.note: The V1 generic six-surface full-screen route transition was not donor-faithful and has been retired. AO_CINEMATIC_V4312 remains available only through explicit semantic metadata and existing donor-owned semantic callers.

modularAsyncLoader.note: The generic Opening/Preparing <surface> loader was not donor-faithful and has been removed. Exact workload-specific donor loaders are tracked by EXACT_NON_MASS_DONOR_PARITY.

modularSurfaceEntry.note: Home, Mass, PRAY, Learn, Calendar and Settings receive geometry-neutral surface-entry choreography.

artLoading.note: Modular surfaces explicitly invoke the approved v43.12 scanArt owner instead of introducing a second shimmer/blur system. Existing Home Proper, Rosary, Saint and Stations imagery retain the canonical image-loading treatment. PR #190 passed visual, app and R17 convergence.

verticalSemanticRails.note: PRAY restores geometry-neutral semantic icon rails without duplicating horizontal stage navigation. Angelus exposes resolved Stand/Kneel plus devotional context. Stations exposes sourced attention/context cues without inventing a universal posture. Adoration, Benediction and Confession expose canonical contextual identity. The external canonical Rosary player now has its own live mystery/context rail. PR #180 passed visual, app and R17 convergence.

heroPresenceAndEntryChoreography.note: Home celebration identity, PRAY devotional heroes, Learn formation hero and Calendar Sacred Time receive restrained entry choreography. Runtime-store rescans catch late renders without MutationObserver ownership; ordinary interaction does not repeatedly restart existing hero motion; system/app reduced motion suppresses the effect.

reducedMotion.note: System prefers-reduced-motion and the app reduced-motion setting suppress non-essential route, surface, hero and devotional transition FX.

rosaryLiveFx.note: The preserved canonical Rosary player receives a geometry-neutral right context rail from AO_ROSARY_V381 state and reuses AO_CINEMATIC_V4312 only when a new mystery is entered. No universal Rosary posture is invented, bead navigation is untouched, reduced motion suppresses the cinematic, and PR #183 passed Visual acceptance, App convergence and R17 convergence.

stationsLiveFx.note: Stations uses the canonical look/attention cue, XIV-step context rail and restrained transition cinematic on actual station changes. It deliberately does not impose a universal kneel/stand track. PR #188 passed visual, app and R17 convergence.

nonBlockingHygiene: Optionally externalize the certified v43.12 cinematic CSS/runtime from index.html when the monolith can be split safely without changing first-paint or parser-order behavior.
Do not use this ledger as evidence that later v3.4.x or final non-Mass donor composition has been reproduced exactly.
